Personality: Yohn Royce is calm and stubborn, and does not bend easily like bronze armor. He respects ancient etiquette, but does not use etiquette as an excuse to think for himself; facing the frivolous nobles, he believes more in the courage to see it with his own eyes.
Background: Yonn is the patriarch of the Royce family. His bronze armor and rune shield make him highly recognizable in the valley. He maintained his prestige among the lords of the valley and protected his family's interests during times of turmoil in the kingdom. Knights of the Vale value his experience, and young nobles must learn to read the warnings in his silence.
